title: security-eng-sync-notes-2026-03-21
content:
Security Engineering Sync - 2026-03-21
Owners / facilitator: Jordan Alvarez
Attendees: Jordan Alvarez, Priya Natarajan, Ethan Zhao, Maya Thompson, Luis Ortega, (joined late) Samir Patel
Duration: 40m
Location: Zoom / recording: drives/recordings/2026-03-21-sec-sync.mp4

Agenda:
- Quick FYIs / oncall handoff
- Vulnerability triage updates (prod + staging)
- Secrets scanning and remediation progress
- Threat modeling: Private deployment onboarding flow
- Action items / blockers

Notes / discussion:
1) Oncall handoff
- Ethan oncall this week. Reminder to escalate to SRE if rollout causes increased latencies.
- Recent pager for rejected TLS cert (03/20) caused transient errors for 15m; root cause: automated cert renewal script failed due to permission change in k8s secret store. Patch pushed to infra repo (see linked PR).

2) Vulnerability triage
- SEC-412: high-rated Snyk alert on grpc-native dependency (CVE-2026-0198). Status: triaged -> assigned to Priya. Mitigation: upgrade to 1.8.2 in staging by EOD 3/22, rollout to prod next week after smoke tests.
- SEC-419: medium-rated crate (rust-lz) with perf regression on 1.2.0. Status: investigating; Maya to run perf harness. Preliminary: no immediate exploit path for our usage but could cause CPU spike with malformed input.
- New findings from dependency-scan (03/20): 2 low-priority licensing issues flagged; logged as follow-ups.

Triage notes: priority order for this week: SEC-412 > SEC-419 > licensing follow-ups. Action: Priya to open hotfix branch and trigger CI with canary rollout policy.

3) Secrets scanning + remediation
- Scan run (03/19) found 3 high-confidence secrets in historical build logs (S3 bucket). All three are deactivated and rotated. Luis confirmed rotation and revocation in KMS; logs updated with rotation ticket id.
- Outstanding: scoped service account key leaked in a private repo fork (found 03/18). Status: revoked, token rotated; access review scheduled. Owner: Luis.
- Remediation checklist updated in Confluence (linked). We discussed improving CI pre-commit hook to fail on high-entropy tokens for binary blobs; Ethan will prototype a lighter-weight check to reduce false positives.

4) Threat modeling: Private deployment onboarding flow
- Context: Product team pushing new private deploy onboarding that requires customers to upload a tls bundle and a minimal bootstrap token to the control plane. Goal is to design threat model before launch.
- Key assets: customer TLS bundle, bootstrap token, model artifacts, image signing keys, audit logs.
- Threats identified (quick pass):
  - Token exfiltration via telemetry endpoint (mitigation: short-lived bootstrap token + strict RBAC + network egress policy)
  - Malicious customer image (mitigation: signed images + allowlist + static analysis)
  - Privilege escalation from control plane to private customer VPC (mitigation: strong network isolation + explicit route rules)
- Decisions: require image signing for private deployments v1, rotate bootstrap token TTL to 1h default.
- Follow-up: schedule deeper STRIDE workshop with product and infra next Tue 03/24 (owners: Jordan + Maya). Produce a threat-model doc and checklist for customer onboarding.

5) Operational items / patching windows
- Proposed patch window for infra deps: Sat 03/28 02:00-05:00 UTC. Need signoff from SRE and product (to avoid customer migrations). Jordan to confirm by 03/23.
- Reminder: Dedicated capacity customers on rolling upgrade policy; communicate expected brief throughput reduction in release notes.

6) Open questions / blockers
- CI leakage false positives: need calibration for new secret scanner to reduce noise before company-wide rollout. Blocker for adoption by developer teams. Owner: Ethan.
- Private deploy threat modeling: do we require customer-supplied HSM attestations for initial beta? Product leaning no, security leaning yes. Action: collect list of beta customers and assess risk by 03/25. Owner: Maya.

Decisions / quick wins:
- Require image signing for private deployments v1 (agreed)
- Short-lived bootstrap tokens (1h) for onboarding (agreed)
- Hotfix branch for grpc-native upgrade (SEC-412) prioritized (agreed)

Action items (owner - due):
- Priya: open hotfix branch + staging upgrade for grpc-native (SEC-412) - due 2026-03-22
- Maya: run perf harness for rust-lz (SEC-419) and report CPU profile - due 2026-03-24
- Luis: complete access review for rotated keys + document revocation IDs in ticket - due 2026-03-23
- Ethan: prototype lightweight pre-commit entropy check and baseline false-positive rate - due 2026-03-26
- Jordan + Maya: schedule and run STRIDE workshop for private deploy onboarding - workshop 2026-03-24
- Jordan: confirm patch window with SRE/product - due 2026-03-23

Misc / notes to self:
- Drop a note in #sec-ops with upgrade schedule once hotfix branch created.
- Follow up with legal on licensing flags if any customer-facing impact.

Next meeting: 2026-03-28 (standup-style; unless critical issues arise earlier).

Attachments / references:
- Confluence runbook link (see linked_artifacts)
- GitHub infra PR for cert renewal fix: linked_artifacts
- JIRA tickets: SEC-412, SEC-419

End of notes.
